name: Braille
description: A braille cell: six positions, and only some of them raised.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); line-height: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 230%; :after { content: "\@hex(@rand(10241, 10495))"; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
